summary: Expanded the universe around regulated utility and LNG/oil-gas infrastructure capex with a two-lane approach. Reference context is Hubbell, a scaled utility-grid supplier. The discovery lane emphasizes less obvious public suppliers and contractors whose exposure is embedded in transmission hardware, electrical distribution equipment, LNG terminals, gas peak-shaving, and utility power infrastructure. This pass avoids hyperscaler, nuclear, and mega-cap power leaders except where needed as context. No buy/sell view is implied.
